d:
China and Korea delivered an unforgettable battle at the FIBA Women's Asia Cup 2023!
Korea came out firing, taking a 21-12 lead in the first quarter, but China fought back and turned the game into a back-and-forth showdown. With neither team able to pull away, the score was tied at 72-72 at the end of regulation, sending this incredible matchup to OVERTIME!
That's when Xu Han took over! She finished with a monster 33 points, 11 rebounds and 4 blocks, while Li Meng added 26 points, 8 rebounds and 7 assists to lead China to a dramatic 87-81 victory.
